title: Kammler black-world program in Nazi Germany
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kammler black-world program in Nazi Germany, about 1940s at Nazi Germany, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, you have these rumors that you had Kammler stuff in in Nazi Germany where they were doing kind of black world nuclear stuff.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions rumors that in Nazi Germany in the 1940s an official named Hans Kammler ran secret, off-the-books nuclear work, what he calls black-world projects. Michels raises it as a possible early root of hidden advanced technology programs.
